definitions.explanation: The act of translating from a foreign language into Japanese, or the resulting translated text.

examples.japanese: この{文|ぶん}を{和訳|わやく}してください。
examples.english: Please translate this sentence into Japanese.

examples.japanese: {英語|えいご}の{記事|きじ}の{和訳|わやく}を{読|よ}んだ。
examples.english: I read the Japanese translation of the English article.

examples.japanese: {契約書|けいやくしょ}の{和訳|わやく}を{用意|ようい}するのに{時間|じかん}がかかった。
examples.english: It took time to prepare the Japanese translation of the contract.

notes:
USAGE:
Can be used as a noun or as a suru verb ({和訳|わやく}する). Commonly contrasted with {英訳|えいやく} (translation into English).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {和訳|わやく}する (to translate into Japanese)
- {和訳|わやく}{版|ばん} (Japanese-translated version)
- {直訳|ちょくやく}と{和訳|わやく} (literal translation and Japanese translation)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {英訳|えいやく}: translation into English
- {意訳|いやく}: free or liberal translation
- {直訳|ちょくやく}: literal translation
